callees.name: validate_llm_setting
callees.pre_condition: key is a string identifying an LLM configuration field name; value is a string representing the desired new value for that field.
callees.post_condition: Completes without error when key is a recognized LLM configuration field name and value conforms to the expected type and format for that field. Raises an error when key is not a recognized field name or value does not satisfy the field's type and format constraints.
